title: The Brightside | Park Free | Walk to Broadway
description:
Nestled in a quaint neighborhood only four blocks to the BroadwayStrip where you'll find all the famous Honky Tonks! Additional close attractions include: Ascend Amphitheater, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Printers Alley, Johnny Cash Museum, Ryman Auditorium, Country Music Hall of Fame & much more!!

Spend the day exploring everything Nashville has to offer, and then return home to a retro-inspired, cute & cozy condo in the heart of the city! :-)

The space
✦ This darling one-bedroom condo includes a luxury queen sized memory mattress. There’s also a really comfy couch and a Twin XL sized air mattress available.

✦ Fresh linens and towels are provided along with essential toiletries such as shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and soap.

✦ Coffee, cream, sugar are all provided. The kitchen is stocked with everything you need including dishes, cookware, silverware, cooking utensils, drinking glasses, wine glasses, general spices/oil. So, you can easily make a meal, have something delivered, or dine out at one of the many amazing restaurants that Nashville has to offer!

Guest access
✦ All guests will have access to the entire condo as well as the community courtyard area that offers lounge chairs and tables. There is also a community washer/dryer available for you to use for a small fee. They are available on a first come, first served basis.
